verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a relay, edge, or forward proxy that a platform engineer can self-host to serve flags during a vendor outage or keep SDK traffic inside the network. SDK local evaluation after initialization and SDK-managed caching are adjacent SDK behaviors, not a deployable proxy, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to a feature-flag platform, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network
